Personally though? I know that my data is out there, it's needed to use a site (ex: things like baseline cookies will always be required) so feel like the second version would work just as fine.

The data declaration should be separate from the technical permissions. Contrary to permissions, the data declaration is just that; it's not a permission. Not granting that "permission" will not prevent the extension from accessing and collecting/sending the data anyway. But technical permissions would.
